statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low with NQ closed; Stress stays extreme but eases slightly as reported Hormuz throughput improves while Saudi security and pipeline risks persist.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. No live NQ price-path evidence is available; weekend geopolitical and energy-route uncertainty remains the principal risk channel.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress; Hormuz flow improves while Saudi risks persist
body: NQ futures are closed, so one-way continuation, retracement quality and session-extreme behavior cannot be observed. CENTCOM says crude, cargo and LNG volumes through Hormuz over the past two weeks are at a six-month high, partly offsetting unresolved Riyadh-area and Saudi pipeline risks.

lookbackSummary: Over the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail peaked at 24% during Friday event/whipsaw conditions and fell to 14% after the close. Weekend Tail stayed low while Stress rose to 90% as Saudi security and energy-route risks intensified.
outlookSummary: All 24 forecast slots remain before scheduled Sunday NQ reopening. If reported Hormuz-flow improvement persists and no new Saudi or shipping shock occurs, Stress can ease while Tail stays low; pre-reopen gap uncertainty rises modestly later Sunday without implying observed one-way structure.
